text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Seems my "Formula for Victory" 
still has room for improvement...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: However, I will not break. I am still...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
HA-YA-HI-DEEEEEE!! That was such an 
incredible run...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, that's exactly why!! 
It made me realize I can still keep 
going!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We'll train more and more...! And run the 
most incredible race ever, Hayahide!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket... Aahh!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Someday, without fail. The 
three of us, together—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haa, ngh... haa...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...As you... can see. I'm not... doing 
well at all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haha... Look at me, what a pathetic sight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Supporting her shoulders as she could 
barely stand, I somehow managed to help 
her back to the waiting room...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sorry. ...I caused you trouble.
choice_data_list: It's not a bother at all...!
It's not a bother at all...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"No, normally speaking, that'd just be a 
nuisance."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Hayahide and Ticket get stronger 
and stronger made me panic and push too 
hard, and I ended up wrecking your 
training schedule.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...And this is the pathetic result.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I guess it's only natural people look down 
on me. A weak little squirt like me—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ngggh, I know!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I know that! I know the folks at the 
academy acknowledge me, and I know there 
are people cheering for me in the crowd 
too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That you've... always, always believed in 
my strength.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Deep down, I knew it all along!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So... ngh, it's not that. ...It's about 
me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Not believing in my strength either. 
Refusing to accept that I'm just a short, 
pathetic, twisted, hopeless nobody.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
All of it, every single part... makes up 
who I am!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...It was completely meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If I can't even accept myself... then 
running just to gain other people's 
approval was completely pointless...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sorry. ...I'm just a bit tired.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Let me rest... for a bit. From races... 
and training...
